cards.title: Who can do this
items: Any signed-in role: open, add, walk through, snooze, reschedule, follow up, remind, repeat, away list, ask Reem, Run now
Owner or admin (todo.close): Done, Skip, Delete, Restore, Reopen, Yes it's done, Not yet; members don't see them
Owner or admin: working days (brand.write); On/Off pills and routine switches (schedule.write)

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are still paused (CLAUDE_PAUSED in model.ts)
Reem replies 'The agents are paused for now…'; no to-do is written, no credits used
Weekly plan Run now: 'Content generation is paused for now. No credits were used.'
Reminders, repeats, the walk and the evening wrap need no model and still work; routines answer retry:paused

cards.title: Limits and gaps
items: 200 new to-dos a day per account; 500 open per brand; 600 writes an hour
Chat: paid 30 an hour and 150 a day, trial 10 and 30, plus the monthly allowance
Reminders arrive in the app and by email; no WhatsApp or Telegram reminders yet
Weekly plan: 2 credits a run; added brands start with it off
Weekly Run now codes: already_this_week, trial_over, cap_reached, no_credits, retry:locked, no_brand
The Team follow-ups card always reads 'Last run: Never'
